propositions: The scheduled Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails on live navapbc/rebar because .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys (LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO) that do not exist in live REB Jira.

The fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out iterates over all keys in projects.json and issues one jql_active query per key; when key LEG is processed, the query 'project = LEG AND status != "Done"' is rejected by Jira because project LEG does not exist.

The live projects.json must be restored to the canonical single-project state {"version": 1, "legacy_default": "REB", "projects": {}} to make the empty projects dict fall back to the default project REB.

The corruption was introduced by ad-hoc git commits on the live tickets branch (commits 9f1b2cff98 and 275bd7507e) with the test-fixture git identity, violating the requirement that all tickets branch mutations must use the unified store write lock and auto-commit+publish.
The projects_store write path lacks the locked+committed+published invariant that other store mutations enforce, enabling ad-hoc hand-commits to corrupt the live branch.
